requirements.text: The Clarus system shall collect, quality check, and disseminate surface transportation environmental data including atmospheric, pavement, and hydrologic data.
The system shall implement a one-stop Internet portal for all surface transportation environmental observations.
The system shall perform continuous quality checking of data with feedback to operators of the originating sensor stations.
The system shall support data transfer in one common protocol with full metadata.
The system shall manage users' rights to input or extract specific data components.
The system shall support the inclusion of new technologies such as vehicle-based sensors, surface visibility information from traffic cameras, and remote sensing technologies.
The system shall provide data with and without post-processing, ready to be incorporated into value-added products.
The system shall control access to modify the system state, quality rules, and set data retrieval schedules.
The system shall manage data sharing restrictions based on contributor agreements.
The system shall be designed to minimize data age and latency from collection to dissemination.
The system shall be scalable to handle large volumes of data from a variety of sources and at high rates.
The system shall implement watchdog services to monitor system state and restart unresponsive services.
The system shall provide high availability through hardware and software redundancies.
The system shall provide a configuration and administration user interface for managing metadata, quality rules, and system operations.
The system shall be standards-based, utilizing non-proprietary and broadly supported information technology industry standards, specifically NTCIP 1204 for environmental sensor station interfaces.
